articles.title: Saudi-backed forces launch a major attack on Houthi rebels in Yemen, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Iran-backed Houthis also fired two cruise missiles at Riyadh, following a major attack by the Saudi-backed coalition on the rebel group’s missile and drone capabilities. Meanwhile, a state-run oil giant in the United Arab Emirates said on Wednesday one of its vessels was attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz the day before. In Iran, protests erupted on Tuesday over a deadly bus crash over the weekend, and an Israeli court rejected a request to release a high-profile Palestinian doctor detained since 2024.

articles.title: Saudi-backed forces launch major attack on Houthis, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Iran has fired on a U.S. air base in Kuwait and at Bahrain in what appeared to be retaliation for American fire a day earlier. Iran-backed Houthis also fired two cruise missiles at Riyadh, following a major attack by the Saudi-backed coalition on the rebel group’s missile and drone capabilities. Meanwhile, a state-run oil giant in the United Arab Emirates said one of its vessels was attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz. Protests erupted in Iran over a deadly bus crash, and Israeli strikes in Gaza killed two Palestinians.
